description: Run an automated check on a release. Pick ONE with `check`: `validate` returns problems that would block distribution (human-readable `errors` + machine-readable `errors_structured`); it changes nothing and is safe to repeat — run it before distributing. `refresh_quality_report` re-runs the Preflight QC checks (read the report with get_release_review view quality_report); an hourly refresh budget may rate-limit frequent calls. Preflight QC is an optional add-on.
name: run_release_checks
title: Run release checks
